thread:
Mira: kicking off a gray release for eviction-v2 on 10% of prefixed caches. need quick sanity checklist — no perf regressions, no cross-tenant corruption, metrics + rollback hooks.
Alex: what's the exact rollout gating? latency p50/p95? error rate? observed eviction churn?
Jia: eviction-v2 is soft-demote-first: demote to warm slab with 30s grace then hard-evict after N misses. It adds tenant-weighted hysteresis. Invariants: no duplicate residency tokens, idempotent demote+evict ops.
Sam: add these metrics: evict_rate_per_tenant, demote_failures, residency_ops/sec, prefetched_kv_miss_ratio. Also track 'stale-read-errors' too.
Isabel: canary plan: run 1 shard per AZ at 5% for 2h, then 10% for 24h. If demote_failures > 0.1% or stale-read-errors spikes > 2x -> rollback.
Mira: +1. also need a smoke test to hit long-running cursors. add a canary script.
Jia: test script (run from k8s debug pod):
```bash
# simulate hot cursor walk + reads
for i in {1..1000}; do curl -s "http://localhost:8080/prefix/read?cursor=hot-$((i%50))" > /dev/null; done
```
Alex: what about lease handoff races? eviction-v2 relies on epoch tags. If handoff overlaps demote, we must ensure demote wins or is safely retried.
Jia: we've added 'demote_cas' that returns EPOCH_MISMATCH; caller retries on new epoch. Race should be benign. We'll log 'demote_epoch_mismatch' metric.
Sam: ops playbook: if we see errors, step 1: scale down gray group to 0, step 2: revert to eviction-v1 on group, step 3: roll forward hotfix. Need a runbook snippet.
Mira: can someone add a dashboard? I want P50/P95 latency, demote_success_ratio, demote_epoch_mismatch, stale_read_rate, and a poisson of eviction bursts.
Isabel: I'll add dashboard; also add alert: demote_success_ratio < 99.5% sustained 5m -> page.
deploy-bot: deployment started for group 'gray-evict-614159' on 10% nodes :rocket:
Sam: observed small burst of demote_epoch_mismatch in canary after 3m — was ephemeral. logging shows retry succeeded.
Alex: please capture a heap of metadata when mismatch occurs: prefix_id, prev_epoch, new_epoch, node_id.
Jia: added structured log example:
{"ts":"...","event":"demote_epoch_mismatch","prefix":"pfx-1234","prev":42,"new":43,"node":"us-west-2b-09"}
Mira: one more: ensure migration doesn't drop the 'pin' semantics. soft-pinned prefixes shouldn't be demoted even under pressure.
Jia: soft-pin preserved: demote checks pin_count and skips if >0. We're good.
Isabel: OK rolling on schedule; will notify 24h health check pinned to 'engineer-oncall' channel.
Mira: thanks team — followups: add canary smoke-run to CI, docs for rollback playbook, and postmortem template in case.
